programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: Kinds of Kindness
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated stories.Emma Stone, Jesse Plemons and Willem Dafoe play various roles.A corporate manager (Jesse Plemons) lives under the dictates of an eccentric boss (Willem Dafoe).She puts his well-being above her own and doesn't question any outlandish demands.Stripped of his dignity, he tries to free himself from total control.A policeman (Jesse Plemons) misses his wife (Emma Stone) - a biologist who disappeared during a research expedition.A woman who survived the disaster returns, but her marriage is put to the test.The husband becomes paranoid and is not sure whether this is the same beloved he once married.The heroes of the last story are members of a sect who are looking for a person with the power to resurrect the dead.The work of Yórgos Lánthimos - the director of "Poor Creatures", which won four Oscars.For his performance, Jesse Plemons was awarded the Palme d'Or at Cannes.

programme.title: Summer Camp
programme.desc: As children, Ginny (Kathy Bates), Nora (Diane Keaton) and Mary (Alfre Woodard) spent every summer together.When, after 50 years, there is an opportunity to meet again - at a summer camp meeting, the friends decide to take advantage of it, although with varying levels of enthusiasm.The least satisfied with her holidays is workaholic Nora, who feels best in her own company.Despite this, she and her friends take on new challenges, such as rafting or a rope park.Additionally, there, the woman meets her former lover, Stevie D (Eugene Levy).Thanks to him and the camp atmosphere, things start to change.

programme.title: The Idea of You
programme.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.

programme.title: A Picture Of Her
programme.desc: Beth (Rhiannon Fish) works as first mate on a fishing vessel.He goes ashore for a while to take care of his aunt (Samantha Ferris), who has broken her leg.During her daily shopping, photographer Jake (Tyler Hynes) secretly takes a photo of her choosing flowers.A freelancer sends a photograph of a stranger to a newspaper under a pseudonym.Some time later, Beth and Jake meet in person.They both turn out to be dog lovers, and over time they discover that they have a lot in common.The lovers' relationship is getting closer.Then Beth's photo appears on the cover of a magazine and goes viral, making her very popular.The woman wants to find the author, meanwhile Jake does not have the courage to confess the truth.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Spaceships land in twelve different places on Earth.No one knows why the aliens chose these locations.The American military is trying to solve the mystery.For this purpose, the soldiers build a camp next to one of the mysterious objects.A talented linguist, Dr. Louise Banks, is called there.Together with Colonel G.T.Weber and physicist Ian Donnelly tries to find out what the real intentions of aliens are and determine whether humanity is in danger from them.Soon, Louise is sent to a spaceship to talk to representatives of an alien civilization.He must unravel the rules of the newcomers' language.He realizes that time plays a key role in the mysterious message.

programme.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever
programme.desc: The Herdman clan has a bad reputation in the town.Unruly siblings steal and bully their peers.Wherever he appears, he causes chaos and goes completely unpunished.Meanwhile, the residents, under the direction of the newly elected organizer, Grace (Judy Greer), are preparing for the annual Christmas nativity play.To everyone's surprise, Gladys Herdman (Kynlee Heiman) and her relatives want to appear in the show.Grace casts a girl as Mary, which complicates preparations for the play and causes widespread dissatisfaction.

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Industry
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of young bankers in Great Britain.Pierpoint, Harper (Myha'la) and Yasmin (Marisa Abela) live the lavish life they dreamed of as graduates.The financiers are drawn into a tense game when a fintech genius appears on the London scene.Yasmin develops a relationship with Sir Henry Muck (Kit Harington), and Harper is drawn into the web of influence of the mysterious director, Whitney Halberstram (Max Minghella).Under the pressure of money and power, the friendship of young women is put to the test.

programme.title: On Swift Horses
programme.desc: 1950s. Newlyweds Muriel (Daisy Edgar-Jones) and Lee (Will Poulter) move from Kansas to San Diego, where a new home and job awaits them.At this time, the man's brother, Julius (Jacob Elordi), who has just returned from the Korean War, reappears in their lives.The former veteran is an accomplished poker player.So he goes to Las Vegas, where he supervises a casino and becomes friends with another gaming enthusiast, Henry (Diego Calva).All this time, she corresponds by letter with her sister-in-law.The woman, bored with her everyday life, is fascinated by the world of gambling in which her brother-in-law operates.Under his influence, he secretly begins betting on horse races.She soon leaves her husband and sets off on an exciting journey together with his brother.

programme.desc: Nora (Noée Abita) is 26 years old and has recently graduated from law school.She is just assigned her first criminal case, which turns out to be a plunge into the deep end.While in custody, he meets his client, a 19-year-old boy accused of murdering his neighbor.Even though it looks like everyone has already passed judgment on him, she has a lot of doubts.Gradually, through this case, Nora becomes aware of the cruelty of the world around her.He also makes many mistakes that make him start to doubt his life choices.

programme.title: Long Good Thursday
programme.desc: Finland.A widowed farmer becomes a model for the eccentric artist Saimi.A feeling develops between them.This does not please the man's adult sons, who are afraid of losing their property.

programme.title: The Last Vermeer
programme.desc: The Netherlands after World War II.The accountability of Nazi criminals and their accomplices continues.A Jew, Joseph Piller (Claes Bang), who fought in the resistance movement, is to deal with the case of stolen works of art.He accuses the eccentric painter Han van Meegeren (Guy Pearce) of collaboration, who hosted Germans at his hedonistic parties and sold them valuable paintings.The artist faces a death sentence.However, he claims that he traded in fakes he created.His exquisitely crafted fakes are indistinguishable from the originals.Although the evidence points to van Meegeren's guilt, and accepting his version would make the brilliant forger a national hero, Piller begins to believe him.Together with her assistant (Vicky Krieps), she tries to prove his innocence, putting her career and good name on the line.Based on facts, the extraordinary story of a Dutch painter and one of the best art forgers in history.It was based on the biography of Han van Meegeren by Jonathan Lopez.

programme.title: Warcraft

programme.title: Good Guy With A Gun
programme.desc: After the violent death of his father, teenage Will (Beck Nolan) and his mother, Tessa Greenwood (Tiffany Bedwell), move to a small town in Illinois.There is a house they inherited from an ancestor, which the woman intends to sell.There, Will meets boys his own age and quickly becomes friends with them.The new friends are fascinated by the weapons each of them has and spend time practicing their shooting skills.Will begins to share their passion, which even worsens his already not good relationship with his mother, complicates the mourning for his father, and even puts the boy's life in danger.

programme.title: Drazen
programme.desc: 1970s.Teenage Dražen Petrovic (Tonko Stosic) living in Šibenik discovers, thanks to his older brother, Aleksander (Lovre Tanfara), that he has a talent for playing basketball.At first, he trained only with him or alone - in the evenings in the gym.When his abilities are noticed at school, he joins the local team, Šibenka, where he is successful.During this time, he falls in love with Renata (Romina Tonkovic).Over time, a talented young man (Domagoj Nizic) goes to a club in Zagreb and then abroad, among others.to Real Madrid, and finally received an offer to play with the New York Brooklyn Nets team, part of the NBA league.Unfortunately, Dražen's passion for basketball also becomes his curse, and success is associated with problems in his personal life, also in his relationship with Renata.A biographical story about the outstanding Croatian athlete, called the Mozart of basketball, who was the first European to play in the NBA.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Many years before Snow White's birth, Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron) observes the actions of her sister, Freya (Emily Blunt), who is in love with a man named Andrew.Soon their daughter is born.Shortly thereafter, the child is murdered.At the same time, Freya discovers that she has the power to control ice.The woman leaves Ravenna's lands with a broken heart.He creates his own kingdom and an army of deadly hunters.There is only one rule in their ranks: never to love.It is broken by two warriors - Eric (Chris Hemsworth) and Sara (Jessica Chastain).Freya decides to separate them.Seven years later, after Ravenna's death, Snow White decides to get rid of the evil queen's mirror, moving it to the sanctuary.Some time later, William informs Eric that the soldiers who were responsible for the expedition have gone missing.The hunter suspects Freya - the mirror could significantly increase her power.He agrees to complete the mission, with the help of the dwarves.
